title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after 33 years, Colette Kress named interim chief
caption:
Jensen Huang has resigned as chief executive and board member of Nvidia, the company he co-founded in 1993. Nvidia gave no reason; Huang admitted an affair on Sunday, and US media reported links to a woman suspected of spying for China, which Beijing denies. Finance chief Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
